definition.absenceRule: Absence is known only after a compatible registry volume validates. A runtime path missing from the registry is a counterexample and yields Unknown.
definition.admitWhen: The frozen release shipping manifest contains a File destination under Web Server Extensions\16\TEMPLATE\LAYOUTS ending in .aspx.
The frozen FilesToRedirect.sts.xms authority contains the ASPX name.
definition.targetResolution: If the target setup artifact is absent from the same frozen shipping authority, retain the request identity as ReferenceUnavailable.

LinkedPhysicalCustomized.assessment: Link to one verified customized physical inventory key and FileUniqueId.
LinkedPhysicalCustomized.compare: Compare physical content once plus customized-origin reference semantics.
LinkedPhysicalCustomized.pnpGraph: Reference the existing customized physical node exactly once.
LinkedPhysicalCustomized.repro: Plan one physical action and preserve customized origin.

LinkedPhysicalGhosted.assessment: Link to one verified physical inventory key and FileUniqueId.
LinkedPhysicalGhosted.compare: Compare physical content once plus origin/registry reference semantics.
LinkedPhysicalGhosted.pnpGraph: Reference the existing physical node exactly once.
LinkedPhysicalGhosted.repro: Plan one physical action regardless of reference count.

NonAspx.assessment: Retain the source observation as a negative ASPX classification.
NonAspx.compare: Exclude from ASPX equality while retaining evidence.
NonAspx.pnpGraph: Do not create an ASPX PageArtifact from this observation.

ReferenceOnlyAvailable.assessment: Emit a typed reference observation with no physical identity.
ReferenceOnlyAvailable.compare: Compare registry-bound request identity; payload equality is not implied.
ReferenceOnlyAvailable.pnpGraph: Create a Reference node or edge; do not create PageArtifact bytes.
ReferenceOnlyAvailable.repro: ReuseTargetProvider only with target capability evidence; otherwise Delegate.

ReferenceUnavailable.assessment: Preserve unavailable evidence; do not synthesize an identity or empty payload.
ReferenceUnavailable.compare: Denied/failed is Incomplete; unresolved registry identity is Unknown.
ReferenceUnavailable.pnpGraph: Keep an explicit gap edge and no physical node.
ReferenceUnavailable.repro: Skip unsafe dependent writes; required dependencies remain Delegate/degraded.

Unknown.assessment: Preserve raw evidence and fail closed.
Unknown.pnpGraph: Do not guess a physical or virtual node kind.
Unknown.repro: Do not execute an unsafe dependent write.

VirtualHandler.assessment: Emit a typed runtime dependency with no physical identity.
VirtualHandler.compare: Compare handler/path/registry/build; incompatible binding is Unknown.
VirtualHandler.pnpGraph: Create a runtime/reference dependency, not a PageArtifact.
VirtualHandler.repro: Never upload; require target capability evidence or Delegate.

normalization.collisionRule: If any normalized explicit path or expanded reviewed alias maps to more than one referenceId, reject the registry and return Unknown.
normalization.legacyLcidAlias: Map /_layouts/{decimal-lcid}/x only when x is present in FilesToRedirect.sts.xms
